theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_mu_uniform_of_equilipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid n)) (F : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (a L : ℝ), IsCompact K → (∀ x ∈ K, Tendsto (fun k => F k x) atTop (𝓝 a)) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ x' ∈ K, |F k x - F k x'| ≤ L * dist x x') → TendstoUniformlyOn F (fun _ => a) atTop K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
